title: trema scaberrimum
intro: Trema scaberrimum, commonly known as the Liane, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cannabaceae. It is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as its use as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Trema scaberrimum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Trema scaberrimum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, although further research is needed to fully understand its chemical composition and potential uses.
